* fix(dogfood): fail no-work copilot runs and skip versionless pins

A run whose every agent output is the no-work placeholder now reports
failure instead of success. Central-management opt-out drops the versionless
audit package references before restore, and the brick guide names
IBrickRegistry.GetBrick.

Co-authored-by: icfrelinger <icfrelinger@gmail.com>

* fix(uat): expect the no-work copilot receipt

The mock task is success false with the placeholder summary. Tier 1 and
tier 10 still required success true, so the API lanes went red. Tier 10
still fails the shared-agent Executing crash.

Co-authored-by: icfrelinger <icfrelinger@gmail.com>
